items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I only know Seabrook. Who is Seabrook? He was a trumpet player.

ctx.x: Did you know the guys in the Carolina Cotton Pickers?
I only know Seabrook. Who is Seabrook? He was a trumpet player. When he leaves, the notes would be up in the ceiling. Just whistle. You know like Cat Anderson do? He whistle trumpet all night.
Well, there's so many guys came out of that band. And Snookum Russell had a big band one time too.
